questions.question: What is communication? Name four different ways people communicate.
questions.expected_answer: Communication means sharing information, ideas, feelings or messages with other people, from a sender to a receiver. People communicate by speaking, writing, pictures and signs, body language, sign language, and using phones, radio, television and the internet.

questions.question: How did people communicate long ago, before telephones and the internet?
questions.expected_answer: They spoke and passed on history through oral tradition, such as stories, songs and praise poems. San artists painted and engraved on rocks. Messengers and runners carried messages, and some communities used drums, horns or fires as signals. Later, people wrote by hand, and from about 1450, printing presses made books.

questions.question: Give two ways communication has changed and two ways it has stayed the same.
questions.expected_answer: Changes: messages travel much faster and further; mass communication like radio, television and the internet reaches millions; people can send photos and videos in seconds. Continuity: people still talk face to face, tell stories, sing, use body language, write letters and cards, and praise poets still perform.
